| column name | definition |
| ------------------ | ------------ |
| uuid                | unique id |
| region             | target region, 3-letter code | 
| summit           | 3-letter summit code |
| date                |  iso-8601 date |
| year                | 4-digit year |
| days_in_m     | days in the month |
| potential_evaporation_1 | average monthly potential evaporation |
| temperature_2m | average monthly temperature of 2 m (K) |
| total_precipitation_1 | average monthly precipitation (mm) |
| temp                | average monthly temperature of 2 m (ºC)  |
| PE                    | potential evaporation (negative values) | 
| prec                  | monthly precipitation |
| D                       | water balance: prec + PE |
